text:
maya: hey all, first day here :wave: i'm able to sign into Console (staging) via SSO but when i try to open Admin -> Feature Flags or toggle a flag i get a 403. says permission denied. anyone know the usual step i missed?
devon: welcome! usually a group/role issue from Okta/SCIM. did you finish the MFA step on the SSO page? sometimes provisioning waits until MFA complete.
maya: yup i did the MFA flow. signed in at 10:12. i can view dashboards but the toggle button is greyed out and error toast says `insufficient_permissions`.
irene: @maya check if you're in the `console-feature-admins` group in your profile settings. go to Console -> Profile -> Organizations/Groups. if you don't see that group you'll get read-only.
maya: i don't see groups listed under my profile, only email and org.
samir: hi @maya, i'm infra. SCIM provisioning had a backlog this morning (deploy churn). i kicked a reprovision job for your user, should finish in ~2-5m. i'll also confirm the FF_ADMIN mapping.
sre-bot: provisioning-job-1839123456 started for user maya — queued -> running -> success (estimated 30s).
devon: if reprovision doesn't show groups, try logging out completely and back in (SSO session sometimes caches old claims).
maya: ok logged out, logged back in. still no groups listed. the feature flag page still 403.
samir: hmm, looking at the audit logs i see SCIM success but role mapping failed because your Okta attribute `employeeType` was blank. we'll set fallback mapping and add `console-feature-admins` manually. doing it now.
samir: added `console-feature-admins` and `console-admin` roles to maya. can you retry toggling?
maya: tried again — i can open the flags UI now and toggled the test flag in staging, no 403. :tada: thanks!
irene: quick note for new-hires: if you hit this, check MFA + re-login, then ping infra with your email. we usually handle SCIM issues quickly but good to call it out.
devon: also FYI prod access requires an additional approval workflow (security signoff) — staging is faster for initial testing.
maya: super helpful, thanks everyone. tagging @samir for any follow-up on Okta attribute defaults.
samir: will follow up with identity team to set employeeType default for contractors/new-hires to avoid churn. cc'ing idp.
maya: appreciate it! first day is already smoother. :smile:
